## Walkthrough

This pull request updates `bin/jam/test/e2e.ts` to add LMDB test cleanup and a multi-process, per-validator LMDB end-to-end test. It introduces a test that launches multiple validator processes with individual LMDB databases (staggered startup), collects logs until target blocks, and verifies ticket distribution by parsing `addTicket` logs. New helpers `collectLogsUntilBlock` and `extractTicketCount` are added, `rmSync` and `tinyChainSpec` are imported, and the `start` function signature gains an optional `timeout?: number` parameter. Process and DB path tracking and cleanup logic were added.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes
